checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: story travel objectives use galaxy display names, not title-cased ids; failing-first test

impact_assessment.why: The Comms tab showed 'currently in Alpha_Centauri' and 'Sirius System' for 'Sirius Prime'
impact_assessment.benefits: Objectives match the names on the galaxy map
impact_assessment.risks: contract: message text only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Existing story test assertions updated to real names, same strength

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: drop the decorative hull captions the module chips cover on the Ship schematic; failing-first test

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge capture of the Ship tab: the FRM and CORE chips cover 'SEC-.. // VF-CORVETTE', leaving garbled fragments
impact_assessment.benefits: A clean schematic; class name already shown in the panel header
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; five inline SVG strings edited
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test pins the five SVGs; visual re-capture

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: dim disabled btn-hud buttons (TRAIN, UNLOCK, INSTALL, HIRE, diplomacy, VENT) so they read as unavailable; failing-first CSS test

impact_assessment.why: Measured in real Edge: every disabled btn-hud keeps opacity 1 and bright gold, so TRAIN 1 SP with 0 skill points looks clickable
impact_assessment.benefits: Clear affordance on every tab with these buttons; titles already explain why
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; CSS only, applies to all btn-hud variants
impact_assessment.mitigation: Opacity range kept legible (0.4-0.65); re-measure and screenshot

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: stop contract cards shrinking inside the fixed-height list so the claim button and rewards stay inside their row; failing-first CSS test

impact_assessment.why: Measured in Edge: #contractsList is a 380px flex column and cards shrink (scrollHeight 78 > clientHeight 70), so CLAIM REWARD crosses the row divider
impact_assessment.benefits: Rows keep their padding; the list scrolls instead of squashing
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; CSS only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Re-measure scrollHeight vs clientHeight and screenshot

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: orbit-view labels avoid the open target card by seeding the label collision list with its rect; failing-first source pin plus real-browser check

impact_assessment.why: Real Edge capture: with a target selected, labels like 'Sol System H (Fertile' and 'Sol System E (Magma' run under the target card and are cut off
impact_assessment.benefits: Every body keeps a readable name while the card is open
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: reads one DOM rect per frame only when the card is visible; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Skip the read when the card is hidden; verify labels in the browser

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: report the net sell price (quote x trade margin x specialty) from one engine helper, show it in the Commerce table and CLI market, judge profit colouring by it; failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: Trade bot: a sale paid 554/unit for medicines while the Commerce table quoted 418; the table also coloured profit against the raw quote
impact_assessment.benefits: Displayed price equals the cash received; profit/loss chips are right
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive sell_price_net field, sell_price unchanged; dependency: sale and display share _sale_multipliers; concurrency: helper runs under the engine lock; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test compares the displayed net with a real one-unit sale for every commodity; existing trade tests rerun

checkpoints.description: [1/2] engine and CLI net price Phase 4
